title: REST JSON not-found, code member plus x-amzn-errortype
why: The REST JSON spelling: the body names the code in a lowercase `code` member and the same string repeats in x-amzn-errortype. Rule 1 lists `code` among the surfaces an interpreter reads; the header is on the wire but no interpreter reads it, which is why the body must be enough on its own.

expect.name: a near miss the observed code ends with
